coverage_note: Public employees under the Public Employment Relations Act (PERA), 1947 PA 336, MCL 423.201 to 423.217, including local government and public school employees, with the Act 312 compulsory arbitration statute for police and fire. This row does not cover classified state civil service employees, whose bargaining is governed outside PERA; that framework was not captured.

governing_statute.value: Public Employment Relations Act, 1947 PA 336, MCL 423.201 to 423.217
governing_statute.quote: Sec. 15. (1) A public employer shall bargain collectively with the representatives of its employees as described in section 11 and may make and enter into collective bargaining agreements with those representatives.

ulp_limitation_period.value: Six months from the unfair labor practice to the filing and service of the charge, extended for armed-forces service
ulp_limitation_period.quote: No complaint shall issue based upon any unfair labor practice occurring more than 6 months prior to the filing of the charge with the commission and the service of a copy thereof upon the person against whom the charge is made

who_may_bargain.value: Individuals employed by the state, its political subdivisions, public schools, public or special districts and public authorities, commissions and boards, including graduate student research assistants, subject to the exceptions in 423.201(1)(f) and (g). Classified state civil service employees bargain under a framework outside PERA that this row does not cover.
who_may_bargain.quote: (e) "Public employee" means, except as otherwise provided in subdivisions (f) and (g), an individual holding a position by appointment or employment in the government of this state, in the government of 1 or more of the political subdivisions of this state, in the public school service, in a public or special district, in the service of an authority, commission, or board, or in any other branch of the public service.

scope_of_bargaining.value: Wages, hours and other terms and conditions of employment, with prohibited subjects for public school employers listed in 423.215(3)
scope_of_bargaining.quote: to bargain collectively is to perform the mutual obligation of the employer and the representative of the employees to meet at reasonable times and confer in good faith with respect to wages, hours, and other terms and conditions of employment

agency_fee_status.value: Not collectible now. PERA again allows service-fee agreements after 2023 PA 9, and 423.210(5) authorizes required dues or fees, but only upon a Supreme Court ruling that reverses or limits Janus v. AFSCME (2018) or a constitutional amendment; until then Janus bars agency fees from nonconsenting public employees.
agency_fee_status.quote: This act does not, and a law or policy of a local government must not, prohibit or limit an agreement that requires public employees in the bargaining unit, as a condition of continued employment, to pay to the bargaining representative membership dues or service fees. This subsection becomes effective immediately upon, and applies to the extent permitted by, either of the following:
